description: This file contains unit tests for the AppStateRemoteConfig component, focusing on remote gateway configuration updates, token handling, and mode/transport preservation logic.

classes.name: AppStateRemoteConfigTests
classes.description: A collection of test cases verifying remote configuration behaviors within the AppState module.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigSetsTrimmedToken
methods.description: Tests that the remote gateway configuration correctly trims whitespace from the token.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsTokenWhenBlank
methods.description: Tests that a blank token input clears the token value in the remote configuration.

methods.name: syncedGatewayRootPreservesObjectTokenAcrossModeAndTransportChangesWhenUntouched
methods.description: Ensures that the object token reference remains consistent across mode and transport changes when not modified.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigReplacesObjectTokenWhenUserEntersPlaintext
methods.description: Verifies that entering plaintext replaces the object reference with the plaintext token.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsObjectTokenOnlyAfterExplicitEdit
methods.description: Checks that the object token is only cleared after explicit user modification.
